text:
elaine: Quick ping — PR #4582 (migration guide + SDK snippet) can't merge: docs CI linkcheck failing and we need runtime clarification re: reserved capacity + pinned model fallback behavior. cc @sam @mike :eyes:

sam: Can you paste the exact example that's tripping linkcheck? Also which runtime question is blocking — reserved capacity accounting vs. fallback?

elaine: Linkcheck hits vpc-internal.example.com in the YAML for 'private_autoscaling.endpoint'. See snippet:
```yaml
private_autoscaling:
  endpoint: https://vpc-internal.example.com
  reserved_capacity: 4
  scale_policy: standard
```
Blocking Qs:
- If customer pins a model to a dedicated pool in Private, do calls from their VPC count against Dedicated reserved_capacity or the Private pool? (we worded it as 'isolated')
- API: if model_version pinned and canary.enabled=true, will requests automatically fallback to compatible variant when pinned variant not available, or will we return an error?

mike: For the first Q — Dedicated reserved capacity is separate from Private VPC pools today; they don't cross-charge. Private pools are per-customer and isolated. But double-checking with infra team about edgecases with burst/burst_capacity.

sam: For the second Q, runtime current behavior is: if a request hits a pinned model and that exact model version is unavailable, the router will try configured fallbacks in order (explicit model_aliases or fallback list). If no fallback configured, request fails with 503. There's also a global 'auto_variant_fallback' feature flag that's off by default. We should be explicit in docs.

elaine: Perfect — can we get that phrased exactly for the docs? e.g., 'Private pools are isolated from Dedicated reserved capacity; hosting does not move tokens between pools.' and 'If pinned model is unavailable, router tries explicit fallbacks; otherwise returns 503 unless auto_variant_fallback enabled.' Is that accurate?

sam: Yep that's accurate. Add a note to call out canary behavior: canary deploys don't override pinning unless rollout policy permits fallback. I'll leave an approval comment once the wording is updated.

zara: Re: linkcheck — please replace the literal URL with a placeholder and add a small note: '<VPC_ENDPOINT> replace with your VPC endpoint' That will stop linkcheck from hitting external host. I'll re-run the preview.

elaine: Done — pushed update, changed endpoint to https://<VPC_ENDPOINT> and added the fallback wording. CI now passes linkcheck locally. tagging for merge.

ci-bot: docs-ci: preview build started for pr/4582 — staging preview -> https://deploy-preview-4582--docs.redwood.example/ :rocket:

mike: FWIW infra confirmed no cross-charge for burst either. Approving from infra-side.

sam: :thumbsup: reviewing final wording now.
